mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT course_id FROM course_sales_log WHERE course_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY course_id
SELECT DISTINCT reason_type FROM course_sales_log WHERE reason_type IS NOT NULL AND reason_type != '' ORDER BY reason_type
SELECT DISTINCT target_month FROM course_sales_log WHERE target_month IS NOT NULL AND target_month != '' ORDER BY target_month DESC
mapper.insert: insert into course_sales_log ( id, course_id, reason_type, target_month, before_tuition_fee, before_material_fee, after_tuition_fee, after_material_fee, refund_monthly_tuitionFee, refund_material_fee, registered_at ) values ( #{id}, #{courseId}, #{reasonType}, #{targetMonth}, #{beforeTuitionFee}, #{beforeMaterialFee}, #{afterTuitionFee}, #{afterMaterialFee}, #{refundMonthlyTuitionFee}, #{refundMaterialFee}, NOW() )
